'''Janna''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustan]], who lived on [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]] during the time of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Biography==
When she was ten, she was separated from her parents during riots in [[Gadrin]], but she found them again with the help of the [[Heroes of Cularin]]. Shortly afterward, she met with them in a warehouse, to tell them that many children in Gadrin were disappearing.
